notes: The OakBarn Stout Kettle, a Skynet Vessel Widget (OakBarn Brewery, 2026-11-24): a 43 gallon kettle, 21 in wide and 26 in tall with a 6 in bottom skirt. A TC 2 port upper Right; a sight gauge on the Left with TC ports at its Top and Bottom; a TC port at the Left wall (Tangential); a TC 1.5 Thermowell in the Center; a TC 1.5 Bottom Drain centered in the skirt. Its IPs are built in on the ports.
